note: Hand-written fixes used by the scripted 'demo' provider. NOT generated by AI.

patches.root_cause: apply_discount returns the discount amount instead of the discounted price, and the bulk tier uses '>' so exactly 10 units gets no discount.
patches.rationale: Multiply by (1 - percent/100) and compare quantities with '>=' so tier thresholds are inclusive.

patches.root_cause: Inventory.remove never checks available stock, so levels can go negative.
patches.rationale: Raise InsufficientStock before mutating the ledger when the request exceeds availability.

patches.root_cause: average_order_value divides by len(order_totals), which is zero for an empty list.
patches.rationale: Return 0.0 for an empty list, as the docstring specifies.
